installCommand: cd align-app && (test -f pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile || test -f package-lock.json && npm ci || test -f yarn.lock && yarn install --frozen-lockfile || (pnpm i --frozen-lockfile || npm ci || yarn --frozen-lockfile))
